repository.zh: 在 GitHub 上打开本插件

brandDesc.en: The brand mark and its colour family.

quickDesc.zh: 在一级列表展示勾选的供应商。
quickDesc.en: Picked providers follow the official service in the picker's first level.

usernameDesc.zh: 用户名显示在欢迎语与账号行里。
usernameDesc.en: The name shown in the greeting and the account row.

pageZoomDesc.zh: 整个页面按倍数一起缩放。

brandNameDesc.zh: 替换侧栏顶部的品牌文字。
brandNameDesc.en: Replaces the brand text at the top of the sidebar.

brandMarkDesc.zh: 替换各处的品牌标志。PNG、SVG 或 WebP，不超过 2 MB。
brandMarkDesc.en: Replaces the brand mark across the shell. PNG, SVG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

brandWordmarkDesc.zh: 标志旁的品牌名称，优先于品牌文字。PNG、SVG 或 WebP。
brandWordmarkDesc.en: The name beside the mark, ahead of the brand text. PNG, SVG or WebP.

brandImageType.zh: 只接受 PNG、SVG 或 WebP 图片。
brandImageType.en: Only PNG, SVG or WebP images are accepted.

brandImageSize.en: The image is larger than 2 MB.

brandInkDesc.zh: 「文字色」把图片当作形状，按所在位置的文字颜色上色。
brandInkDesc.en: Text colour fills each image with the colour of the text where it stands.

brandAccentDesc.zh: 按钮、选中标记、链接与焦点环的颜色。
brandAccentDesc.en: The colour of buttons, selected marks, links and focus rings.

paletteDesc.zh: 开启后界面用插件的配色。
paletteDesc.en: The skin's own colours while on.

typefaceDesc.zh: 开启后用 Anthropic 的字体。

chatUxManaged.zh: 该选项由插件 dsh-chat-ux 管理

windowsOnlyNote.zh: 只在 Windows 桌面端的窗口里生效。
windowsOnlyNote.en: Takes effect in the Windows desktop window only.

motionStillNote.zh: 动画设为「减弱」时这一项不生效，卡片只显示定格画面。
motionStillNote.en: No effect while Animation is Reduced; the cards show stills.

unavailable.zh: ERROR : 设置存储服务异常，改动不会被保存。
unavailable.en: The settings store is unavailable, so changes will not be saved.

composerRequired.zh: 「重绘对话框」为「关闭」时不生效。
composerRequired.en: No effect while Composer restyle is Off.
